notes.title: Developer Update – Building, Combat, Lore, and More!
notes.notes: [h3]Greetings Seekers,[/h3][p]The ritual continues. Shadows lengthen on Farmouth Island as our team weaves new systems, summons darker threats, and breathes life into every corner of the world you’ve come to haunt. This is your glimpse into what’s next for [b]The Bornless…[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_4db899471c5f4916888315fcfa831fd9~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][h3]BUILDING SYSTEM – YOUR DOMAIN, YOUR DESIGN[/h3][p]Our Building System is nearly ready for prime time, letting you transform resources and scrap gathered on Farmouth Island into structures, fortifications, and decorations for your personal island.[/p][p]Whether you want a practical fortress or something purely aesthetic, you can place items with snap, grid-align, or freeform precision—right down to putting furniture in mid-air if you wish.[/p][p]Structures can be rotated, demolished on the fly, and rebuilt to your liking. We’ve built this system around freedom—unlike many games, there are no strict build zones, so your creativity sets the limits.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_cf9b243774ad4a828b04e1ae822a0f24~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][h3]MOTORBIKE – RIDE THE STORM[/h3][p]From concept sketch to roaring reality, we’re thrilled to introduce a Motorbike that prowls the wilds. Functional headlights, brake lights, fuel and speed gauges—it’s as much atmosphere as it is transportation.[/p][p]Tear through the swamps under moonlight, or kill the lights and vanish into shadow before the hunt begins.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"][/img][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_a09a644459d2479784310c1357f6ab01~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][h3]THE BORNLESS TAROT DECK[/h3][p]A deck born of black magick—rubber-hose style art depicting demons, angels, and mortals of our realm.[/p][p]Ten cards already exist, each carrying hidden lore and whispered secrets. One day, the deck will be whole… and perhaps, usable both in-game and in the physical world.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_f844dab8fd8b447dbc10733db3ddf994~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][h3]RADIO TOWER – THE HEART OF CONFLICT[/h3][p]At the centre of the map rises the Radio Tower: a labyrinth of corridors wide enough for the largest demons, choke points perfect for ambush.[/p][p]This fortress-like landmark will also play host to puzzles, quests, and mini-games, with interconnected spaces designed to support future gameplay mechanics—like locked-door logic puzzles and scavenger-style objectives.[/p][p]We’re really excited for you to unleash hell here![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"][/img][/p][h3][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_2db3b769c02d4ffb8fb62730623bc63a~mv2.gif"][/img]NEW HOUSES – LURKING HISTORY[/h3][p]Our homes now carry the salt-worn bones of Lovecraftian New England.[/p][p]We’ve overhauled our house designs to better match the atmosphere of Farmouth Island, drawing inspiration from Lovecraftian interiors and New England coastal architecture. These homes are more open inside, allowing demons to enter and stir chaos, but still filled with nooks and crannies for humans to hide and plan their next move.[/p][p]These new houses will be making their way onto the island very soon![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_d23769b02dbe416aa34dc523f37119ac~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][h3]CORRUPTION & NEW ENEMIES[/h3][p]Dwell too long in the island’s grip and you will change—ashen skin, glowing eyes, and torn remnants of who you once were. Through progression you will be able to unlock new dark variation of your chosen character — marking you as a battle-hardened veteran.[/p][p]As well as these dark variations we are also introducing new horrors, Shoggoths – Failed angelic experiments dripping with rage.[/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_9c68149c061545fda3eadd6b40b90462~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Stillborn[/b] – Motionless until your back is turned… then lightning-fast.[/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_a447e2cd43524b6ca60fd5574a1bb518~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Brains[/b] – Their exposed brains make them fragile, but they can fly with rapid speed and have a deadly bite.[/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_772bda7959c34d7caec7b522ccc3f0cc~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Tentacles & Growths[/b] – Silent horrors that wait in the dark.[/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_fb9922609e89487989fab41880a008db~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Wardens[/b] – Floating titans wielding divine judgment.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_ac45f2b8cc1049bba7c15e131f7ca626~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][h3]MELEE SYSTEM OVERHAUL[/h3][p]The melee system you all experienced in the Next Fest build was unfinished, and we listened to your feedback to make sure whatever we worked on felt just right.[/p][p]We’ve rebuilt the Melee System from the ground up. The old “hold to charge” mechanic is gone, replaced with intuitive light attacks and unique special attacks per weapon. Updated animations, on-screen blood effects, and hit-stop feedback make every strike feel heavier and more satisfying.[/p][p]There are a few other additions to the melee system and we’re really excited for you to try them out![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_f1821135aae148fd8782449434076b28~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][h3]GUNPLAY IMPROVEMENTS[/h3][p]Your feedback was clear: the gunplay needed more weight. Now, pistols are snappy, sniper rifles deliberate, and movement shifts depending on your weapon’s heft.[/p][p]Weapon sway, smoother transitions, and tactile recoil bring the chaos to life.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_ece93797def34262a83b513d0f40696f~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][h3]THE GREAT SWAMP OF ZABOSLAV[/h3][p]This optional side quest zone introduces one of the many realms belonging to the island’s mysterious entities.[/p][p]Heavy with mist and menace, shrines, hidden lore of Zaboslav, and rewards for the brave. But be warned—Haag and his kin guard it well.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_d3c8d17c749c4b6bbc8397ae0d7f5535~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][h3]UNREAL ENGINE 5.6 UPGRADE[/h3][p]Performance was one of the biggest pieces of feedback that we received post-Next Fest and one we were hyper aware of too. So, we have now moved from UE 5.4 to UE 5.6 as part of our ongoing performance push.[/p][p]The upgrade brings better stability, optimized Lumen and virtual shadow maps, improved hardware ray tracing, and new tools for animation, 3D assets, and Metahuman creation—keeping The Bornless at the forefront of modern tech.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b19aba_f935438e1420476c92ff91f02b4d6d1e~mv2.gif"][/img][/p][h3]SPELL CRAFTING RETURNS[/h3][p]Curses are back.[/p][p]The return of Curses comes with a full Spell Crafting System. Gather ingredients—from herbs and oils to more grotesque finds—across Farmouth Island, extract them safely, and combine them at the spell crafting bench.[/p][p]Discover powerful spells through experimentation, with rare recipes rewarding creativity and exploration.[/p][p]This still needs a bit more time, but we’re really excited to be bringing this back very soon![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"][/img][/p][h3]OUR COMMUNITIES DEEP DIVE[/h3][p]Over the past weeks, our Creators and Partners have been hard at work conjuring unholy content — sharing gameplay, lore, and even exclusive developer updates.[/p][p]We want to shine a light on their efforts, give them a proper shoutout, and invite you to watch their creations.[/p][p]This video from [b]Firewitch74,[/b] one of our Partners, is a must-watch — a super in-depth breakdown of fresh updates coming to The Bornless. If you want the latest, this is where to start.[/p][previewyoutube="6JGurpNjWgg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]TiredEyeBags[/b] gives you the rundown on The Bornless — what to expect, how to survive, and how to escape the fog.[/p][previewyoutube="9_IgsOamN_k;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]A truly unique edit from [b]Rusticmoon VR[/b] — diving into the dark mythos of The Bornless and the Ritual itself. This one’s special.[/p][previewyoutube="oIfrCMvjlmQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]For our Spanish-speaking Seekers — [b]Alma_Caninaa[/b] shares thoughts and reactions to the latest The Bornless updates.[/p][previewyoutube="SH1CifiIsKA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]A hot take: [i]“The Bornless is the Extraction Horror Game that changed everything.”[/i][/p][p]Not our words — but those of [b]HonestlyBretter[/b].[/p][previewyoutube="xtLUukhGGeg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][b]AbsurdNerdz[/b] is doing all she can to summon a new playtest… maybe she knows something we don’t? 👀 [url="https://www.tiktok.com/t/ZT6xvMrTH/?utm_source=chatgpt.com"]Watch Here[/url][/p][p]We are endlessly grateful to every Creator and Partner who continues to keep the flame alive with their videos, streams, and edits.[/p][p]Seekers — watch their work, drop them a follow, and show them some love. This community wouldn’t exist without you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/d1b1f59bad220bc6df2f7b3586b27271ed5be6df.png"][/img][/p][h3]PRE-REGISTRATION EVENT NOW LIVE[/h3][p]Don’t forget our [b]Pre-Registration Event[/b] is still live.[/p][p]Sign up and help unlock exclusive rewards for launch: [/p][p][url="https://thebornless.com/preregister"]https://thebornless.com/preregister[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ccd2caf6b39a64901e2dc271ce9bed8dcc3b403e.png"][/img][/p][p]The island changes. The air grows heavier. The Ritual waits for no one.[/p][p]We see you. We hear you. And we cannot wait to witness the chaos you bring next.[/p][p][/p][p][i]#StayUnholy[/i] [/p][p]- The Bornless Team 🖤  [/p][p][/p][h3]Want to be among the first ones who will experience the true horrors of Farmouth? notes.title: Steam Next Fest was an overwhelming success!
notes.notes:
[p]Now that the dust has settled, the data is clear...[/p][p]Despite server issues and some hilarious (and frustrating) bugs, we had over 60,000 downloads! Players made countless visits to Farmouth Island, it’s safe to say the ritual has well and truly been invoked. But what does the data say? Let’s dive in.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/6093c3c98c2cedbc4694aead17e0853f9d0a4ae7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]First of all, we’d be remiss if we didn’t open with a huge thank you to our community. Thanks to your generosity with feedback, your patience with our development hiccups, and your passion for [i]The Bornless[/i], we’ve come away from Next Fest armed with a ton of useful information to help us improve the game.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/07f8b9520d9b4f4919a0e17a6b0e229de85bffca.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We saw over 5M impressions on our Steam page—from people watching our live streams, to checking out our Demo and reading our news posts. These impressions grew and grew, with us sitting in the top 50 demos during Steam Next Fest, a stat we're particularly proud of.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/0fddf8908cc17d9ccbcc5c2a1b278d46d175d38d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Social Media impressions for the week went through the roof with over 750,000 organic impressions from not only our own content but the content shared by you, and that doesn't include Twitch streams...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/9bd313a542a8ad2c97a91443300c588f2a45ca75.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We saw an incredible amount of people streaming [i]The Bornless[/i] during Next Fest with over 1,000 people streaming the game, all translating to over 250,000 views and over 60,000 hours watched (that's roughly 6.9 years)![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/061ea70445297c53596ce9045265ed803004b591.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our Store Page itself had over 500,000 visits, which is an incredible number to sit at for just one week. We're super proud of that and grateful for all of those who stopped by, checked out the demo, and added [i]The Bornless[/i] to their wishlist.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/6424d147197c86d2b5931bef94618e36927667cd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And we can't forget the Discord community. Our general chat was a non-stop feed of incredible messages from members new and old. From those helping new lambs as a Shepherd (our find a duo set-up) to those raving about the incredible games they played. We saw some incredible clips shared by our community, too, and best of all, we saw nearly 2,000 new people come through the door![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/e765910efb72fa1ddc7fc2aa3e287dd7bd20f17d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We now have over 270,000 people registered to access our future playtests, and we are thrilled with that. We're working hard as we write this post to bring even more exciting content, bug fixes and polish to the game and can't wait to send out invites soon for our next playtest...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/512f0cb8919bb136f0e76ac02357c2789ccc913d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]None of this would’ve been possible without you, so again, thank you. Now, we’re getting our heads down once more, noses to the grindstone, so we can come back bigger and better soon. This was our first Next Fest, and our first widely available demo at this scale. It wasn’t without challenges, but we’re incredibly proud of our efforts, and even more grateful to you.[/p][p]We’ll be back soon, stay Unholy![/p][p]
[i]#StayUnholy[/i]
- The Bornless Team 🖤

[b]Servers will shut down on Monday 16th June at 8 AM UTC.[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]You may have noticed that this weekend we've gifted all players Milton & Sarah—find them in your Soul Mirror. notes.title: Bringing Anti-Cheat to The Bornless
notes.notes:
If you die to a headshot on Farmouth Island... you’ll know it was skill, not software.

We've integrated Tencent’s Anti-Cheat Expert (ACE) into [i]The Bornless[/i], helping to ensure a safe and fair environment for all players in our upcoming playtests.

Extraction shooters, especially FPS games, rely on their players being able to compete in a fair and balanced environment; utilizing all their skill and strategy to take that winning spot. Cheating undermines all the hard work that we as devs have poured into creating a level playing field for all, and ultimately ruins the experience for players looking to compete fairly.

That’s our top priority: ensuring the best and most well-balanced gameplay experience for you. As our player base grows, this only becomes more important.

That’s where Tencent Cloud and Anti-Cheat Expert (ACE) came in.

[h3]Why ACE?[/h3]

ACE is built on nearly 20 years of anti-cheat expertise and a vast database of cheat samples. Using AI-powered detection and big data analytics, ACE identifies and mitigates even the most sophisticated threats, including DMA (Direct Memory Access) exploits and AI-based cheats, before they impact gameplay.

The result? A more secure game, a more engaged community, and a foundation for sustainable success.

Fair play starts with strong security.

notes.title: Developer Update: Localization
notes.notes:
Welcome back to our Developer Update series!

This week, we’re breaking down how one feature alone can help to ensure that our next playtest is more accessible than ever before.

We sat down with Mike, Narrative Designer at Cathedral Studios, to learn more:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/c08b070076aa87a6ef24876cab1d13cc3ac76a15.png[/img]

[h3]What is Localization?[/h3]

In simple terms, localization is the act of translating our game to support our international gamers' local languages. There is more to it than that, of course; not everything can be perfectly translated! But that is the top-level concept: to ensure that players in regions where English is not their first language are just as able to play and enjoy [i]The Bornless[/i] as anyone else.

[h3]Why is Localization so important?[/h3]

Inclusion and accessibility are incredibly important to us at Cathedral Studios. Localization goes beyond simply translating words 1:1, as that can lead to some seriously janky translations! What we try to do is adapt the phrasing and sentences to suit the language we're translating into—that way, we're able to communicate the same concepts and ideas without key information getting lost in translation (pun absolutely intended).

[h3]How are we implementing Localization in The Bornless?[/h3]

As a small studio, we must recognize our strengths and our talents. We have a number of team members who speak various languages (French, Spanish, Danish, Serbian, to name but a few) whom we can lean on to sense-check and QA test some of our localization. For other languages, we'll need to rely on consultants who can plug the gaps in our knowledge.

[h3]How do we decide which languages to prioritize?[/h3]

Until we have the resources to localize The Bornless into every language possible, we do have to be somewhat selective, unfortunately. How we decide really comes down to data: Which global regions have the most native speakers? Which countries have high populations of gamers? By strategically targeting those communities, at least initially, we should be able to reach the highest number of players and ensure that playing our game is as frictionless as possible!

notes.title: Developer Update: Soul Mirror
notes.notes:
Since our last playtest, our developers have been working hard on lots of exciting updates that you’ll be able to experience very soon!

We wanted to share some of the key things we’ve been working on, along with insights from the team.

This week, we’re taking a deep dive into the Soul Mirror.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/f9ee6b99f879e9f40034fe007093d0073985fc4a.png[/img] 

We're really excited to bring more functionality back to the Safehouse. In the last playtest, use of the Soul Mirror was temporarily removed, but for our next big playtest (TBA), it will be returning!

So, what’s the Soul Mirror all about, and how will it impact your gameplay experience?

Let’s hear from Calum, our UI wizard, as he breaks down the work he’s been doing on the Soul Mirror:

[h3]What is the Soul Mirror?[/h3]

The Soul Mirror is the player's primary interface to their collection of characters—both Human and Demon. Here, players can equip characters, read their lore, and acquire new ones. Each character in [i]The Bornless[/i] has their own story and can be individually levelled up, rewarding players with cosmetic unlocks and eventually unlocking a corrupted variant of the character.

On the Demon side, the Soul Mirror allows players to preview each Demon’s unique abilities, unlock rewards through levelling, and even purchase new Demons.

[h3]What have you been working on with the Soul Mirror?[/h3]

The Soul Mirror system has undergone a complete overhaul. However, it isn’t just a task for the UI Team alone; it requires extensive collaboration with the 3D Design Team to create new Human and Demon characters. Our Narrative Department also plays a key role crafting intertwined stories about each character, detailing their history with Farmouth Island and what their motivations are for being there.

Meanwhile, the UI Team has been building out all the front-end functionality to smoothly navigate these systems. And, at this stage, all the necessary 2D art is also in production.

[h3]What can players expect when using the Soul Mirror?[/h3]

New characters and Demons… lots of them!

We’re really looking forward to the Soul Mirror going live and rewarding players for using their favourite characters. You'll have the opportunity to preview playable Demons in detail, including breakdowns of their skills, attacks, and more.

With this update, players will also be able to buy and equip new characters and Demons—something we’re very excited for you to explore!

[h3]What were some of the biggest challenges in designing the Soul Mirror interface?[/h3]

One of the main challenges we've faced is ensuring the Soul Mirror has a great user experience—not just for keyboard-and-mouse users, but also for players who prefer controllers. Ensuring the interface is intuitive and enjoyable for both input methods has been a major focus for us.

notes.title: Character Rework | Harry
notes.notes:
Harry, the protagonist of the first book in The Bornless series, quickly became one of the most loved characters during our playtests, often referred to as "the guy in the trenchcoat." Because of his central role, reworking Harry was a top priority for us. This update not only gives him a fresh new look but also enriches his backstory and his connections with other characters in The Bornless universe. In this article, we will unveil the reimagined Harry, showcasing his new look and exploring his pivotal role in The Bornless, all while avoiding any spoilers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/1e716962fc7e42768665bb4e148f2273e60b0b11.png[/img]
[h3]Who is Harry?[/h3]
For a long time, there was only the job: the investigation, the fight, and the satisfaction of justice served. Then, there was only her—Mary. A bright sun where black clouds once reigned, she lit up everything she touched. Being a detective was still who he was, still a priority, but it was no longer all that he was. Through Mary, he discovered an entire life outside of the force. A world that, ever since she had gone missing, had fallen once more into darkness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/dd11108a1cfd4624e187359e41a6ec40e46fb13c.png[/img]
[h3]Role In The Bornless[/h3]
Harry is another one of the major playable characters within the Bornless universe. Partnered with Denzel, he is a man well-versed in warfare—albeit the violence he had seen prior to the Bornless ritual being invoked was a little more mundane and a little less demonic. With the loss of Mary almost certainly tied to the recent events on Farmouth Island, Harry has no inhibitions about getting his hands dirty. His role may involve invocations, fighting, survival... But his prime directive is to find Mary.

Take a look at Harry in his original form before the character rework:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/b111520ce6b9449da62e8fb59a11f94e458eb2dc.png[/img]

Prepare for significant updates to all our characters, as each undergoes transformations impacting their looks and stories. This is your chance to delve deeper into The Bornless universe.

notes.title: Character Rework | Denzel

In the world of The Bornless, Denzel has always been Harry's reliable partner, battling by his side in every match. To help players connect more deeply and enhance their gaming experience, we have redefined Denzel's character. The way he looks is now more memorable and his backstory is richer, reflecting his experiences in the game. This character rework reveals a bold new vision for Denzel, designed to captivate and resonate with our players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/0852c2d64bd7151f3279f3cfb68d14508c4c92d4.png[/img]
[h3]Who is Denzel?[/h3]
Some men imagine themselves heroes, with illusions of grandeur or a god complex. Not Denzel. His feet have always remained firmly on the ground—until recently, that is. Before Farmouth Island became a haven for demonic cults and supernatural interference, Denzel was just happy showing up every day to work as a detective, shooting the breeze with his partner Harry and taking out the criminal trash. Did he get bored sometimes? Sure, who wouldn’t in this small town? Well, that was until the ritual began…

He had been working alongside Harry for several years before everything changed; before eternal night fell upon Farmouth and monsters walked the land. As a detective, his skills and experience gave him an edge when it came to surviving the events that followed. His role is simple, with a twist: invoke the ancient ritual. Fight. Survive. notes.title: Vehicle Showcase: Solomon’s Pickup Truck
notes.notes:
In the early stages of developing The Bornless, the idea of incorporating vehicles seemed like an odd fit. If asked, "Will The Bornless have vehicles?" we would've likely responded with, "No, what do you mean?" However, as the game world expanded, the necessity for a feature enabling rapid travel between locations became apparent. Fast travel and teleportation didn't align with our vision, leading us to introduce Solomon’s Pickup Truck, the first player-controlled vehicle in The Bornless.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/347c42c4d1ed895b9ae350b0f4c744800084768d.gif[/img]
[h3]Preserving the Eerie[/h3]
Adding this vehicle posed a unique challenge. The Bornless is, at its core, an FPS horror shooter, and vehicles are neither inherently terrifying nor do they shoot bullets. After our 3D Team completed the car's design, the sound design team took the lead, crafting immersive sounds that enhance the experience. Just envision the sound of tires screeching as you drift through the winding streets of Farmouth. These vehicles are housed in garages at specific locations on the map. Accessing the cars involves our Active Interact System, which adds a fun layer to interacting with objects within the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/e8b808f80e7b04756f7c99584ba7ff6c81523ca4.gif[/img]
[h3]Gameplay Design[/h3]
Our design intentionally supports dynamic gameplay scenarios. Whether players are being shot at or chased by a demon, the trucks are designed so that when a player jumps onto the back, they stay put instead of bouncing off. Although the game primarily supports duo play, if you spot a truck and have the skills to jump onto the back, you can execute some impressive James Bond-style takedowns.

notes.title: The Great Prince of Hell
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/09cf5f4ea8ac09a08e6d36355df243ac31611a4d.png[/img]
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ Fog hung thick against the night, the clean mountain air corrupted by the putrid scent of sulfur. Two men stood as still as statues, tucked between trunks and branches; they ignored the sharp, leafless twigs scratching their skin. Snow still dappled the ground where winter held tight to the changing of seasons, the packed earth cold and hard beneath their feet. Approaching footsteps from the darkness seemed to echo, heavy thudding heels that snapped the silence from its stupor and mingled with the occasional crunch of wilting frost.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ “He’s close,” the stranger whispered, his breath becoming white smoke.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/fda7c7c19fcdff69eec11b40cda194ff96b075cb.gif[/img]

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ The footsteps grew louder, as did the sickly smell of sulfur. Gudge wrinkled his nose and blinked an errant tear from his eyes. He held his arms before him, one fist tightly gripping the other. [i]Stop shaking, you fool[/i], he told himself firmly. [i]This is what you wanted, isn’t it?[/i] Gudge’s teeth began chattering as the first shadowy glimpse of their visitor crested the hill.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ “Is that…” Gudge choked on the words, his misted breath sputtering to a stop.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ “Yes,” the stranger replied softly, “that is He. The Great Prince Himself.” Slowly, carefully,  the man bent down and prostrated himself against the frosty ground.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ “Orobas.” Gudge mumbled to no one, his eyes wide with awe and fear in equal measure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/9f7412594092e58e896d320204f9e1da144b71ce.png[/img]

[h3]The History of Orobas[/h3]
Orobas plays a pivotal role in The Bornless, impacting both the game's narrative and its multiplayer dynamics. During the earliest alpha playtests, Orobas was introduced as a formidable NPC demon that instilled fear in players' hearts. At that time the game featured an "Orobas Game Mode". This mode was a unique take on battle royale, featuring 8 players in a fight to the death. Players could invoke Orobas at specific shrine locations on the map in exchange for incense, turning him into an ally who would aggressively pursue and attack nearby players. Orobas also aided in locating and combating enemies in the dark, fog-enshrouded town of Farmouth. However, allying with Orobas was a double-edged sword: aggression towards him, or a rival team offering more incense could turn him against you. This introduced a strategic element of managing incense supplies. Players often faced the dilemma of spending their precious incense on weapons with Haag, a merchant demon within The Bornless universe, or securing Orobas's support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/e14d7476f70bdcaab8b72ab6f84ff7a96262f738.gif[/img]

[h3]What Changed?[/h3]
Orobas's role meant his influence needed careful balancing to ensure fun gameplay. Feedback from players highlighted that Orobas was overpoweringly strong, making games too dependent on his support. The intention was to have Orobas offer a fun advantage, but not to the extent of overshadowing player skill as the primary factor for winning. 

Thus, we rebalanced Orobas, adding anti-camping mechanics and removing his map-wide teleportation ability among many other nerfs and buffs. This led to a split in player experiences: hardcore players learned to dodge and kill Orobas entirely, while casual players still struggled against him. Amid this, the community expressed a strong desire to play as demons, drawn by the allure of embodying The Great Prince of Hell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/ab4df9a4a5862ad81d1b5f663624043f92da0c07.gif[/img]
[h3]The Future of Orobas[/h3]
And so, player-controlled demons came to life in The Bornless. This began with Botis, a colossal snake demon, in the Titan Game Mode. The feedback was overwhelmingly positive, with players enjoying the new dynamic. Alongside this, feedback on weapons, character models, gunplay, and movement laid the foundation for our main game mode, [b]The Ritual Game Mode[/b]. In the next playtest, players will experience this mode for the first time, showcasing an expanded, improved, and optimized version of the original Orobas Game Mode. However, this time Orobas will not be an easily ignored NPC. 


Whether you're in control or it's another player at the helm, Orobas will become a daunting presence. If you're aiming to stay alive and make off with your hard-earned loot once The Bornless Ritual has been unleashed, there's only one thing left to do... [b]Run as fast as you can.[/b]

Thank you for Staying Unholy!

notes.title: The Visions of The Broken Seal
notes.notes:
The night is dark, the moon is full, and the fog is thick.

You are alone, sequestered inside a creaking cabin of hardwood and soft silence. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/acf41e16489d7243ca3a2264b7b9fe8aaa8f1ee2.gif[/img]

Soft, because it is broken often by the gentle groans of the old timber frame. Soft, because it bends beneath the rushing winds that rattle the window panes. Soft like your breath, which flits between being held and pouring out in fits and starts.

Once the wind has finally settled down alongside your breathing, and once your eyes have adjusted to the darkness - turning deep shadows into mere shallow pools of black and gray - you find the strength to explore your surroundings. The place is empty, mostly. It looks like the previous occupants left in a hurry, and that they did so a long, long time ago. Dust, rust, and every other form of decay has laid its claim on this old house. The hint of light draws your attention along the hall, to where an indistinct haze of glowing blues and reds is coming from. It’s so faint you begin to question whether your fragile mind is playing tricks on you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/5cb88123dc4bb037a7d65d334eaec4977340c66c.gif[/img]

And then you feel the coarse crunch of broken glass beneath your feet…

Following the glittering trail of crystal breadcrumbs you find yourself at a round table in an otherwise empty room. The centerpiece of this table is a curious shattered artifact; leaking from its broken heart, a trembling light seems to grow stronger the closer you get to it. Like a feeble flame struggling to fight the wind.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/eab14a4ae371e2e2e4d9bd67f62587ba18e1c830.gif[/img]

Something about it draws you in closer, until your nose almost touches the jagged edges of the broken circle and your eyes are aglow with something magical. Are they images? Visions? Just a trick of the light? It reminds you of innocently peering into a kaleidoscope as a child, only brighter, fuller, and somehow darker, too.

Shapes and colors coalesce before your eyes to become…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/09cf5f4ea8ac09a08e6d36355df243ac31611a4d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/0caaec90b48ca7625011829456b0906acf41dfa5.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474415/9f7412594092e58e896d320204f9e1da144b71ce.png[/img]
